comments.builds: Measured on the dump (Mario Kart World [0400C3F00006E000][v0].nup, base v0 = 1.0.0, no update): nx2/make_game.py --check reported the program id and main's build id, and nx2/lift.py's image line put main at 0x80020000. The same build id and RomFS count (205,660 files) are mkw-recomp's 1.0.0 row (adriadam10/mkw-recomp@5ff4fbb, recomp/versions.py, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Adria). 1.8.0 (main d00e4f39...) is another executable, with other addresses: not this profile's. See docs/mario-kart-world.md.
comments.profile: Empty on purpose until measured: patch modules (a widescreen, lens or jitter patch is a new module), gfx (the frame limiter), hooks (gfx_clock, the present poll), upscale (program keys, from RX_VK_SHADER_CENSUS), and graphics_scale (what the game makes of oe::GetCurrentGraphicsScale is not read yet).
comments.profile.vk_parallel: The parallel replay on 4 threads: this game records most of a race frame in one command buffer. Measured on one RTX 5060 Ti (Linux, NVIDIA 615.71.09, i5-13600K) in a Mushroom Cup race, on/off/off/on twice: the median 1.5-5 fps up, the minimum up to 6, the replay ~2 ms shorter and its thread half as busy (#55). Not measured elsewhere; Ocarina loses a fifth with it (docs/performance.md). RX_VK_PARALLEL=0 turns it off.
comments.released: In the release: its own tile in RecompLauncher (recomplauncher.json games[]), its own copy asked for (inputs[]), which the builder checks against this profile's build id (make_game.py --game-<key>)
